Complete returned tree had README, licence, workflow and keystore-named entries, but no Android application/native build implementation. Not selected or represented as a functioning port. Keystore-named contents were not opened or used.

README and app/build.gradle identify Kotlin, xterm.js and com.github.mwiede:jsch 0.2.25, not PuTTY source. GPLv3 alternative; not copied, built, installed or endorsed here. Its README also discloses passwords in SharedPreferences.
Cargo manifest uses russh (0.63 declaration and vendored patch), not PuTTY. A cross-platform SSH alternative, not evidence of a PuTTY port.

Actual x11-packages/putty recipe selects official 0.85 source and the same pinned SHA256 as the official checksum page; includes GTK/X11 dependencies. A real Android packaging lead, but not a standalone native Android-UI APK. The earlier packages/putty endpoint was the wrong directory and returned 404.

sdf.safeNextAction: The owner obtains the exact current server host key from SDF over a trusted channel, logs into their own account, and runs validate to read current instructions. Any membership payment, sponsorship request or account change requires a separate informed owner action.
sdf.qualification: Successful SSH authentication, account recovery, domain affiliation and SDF membership validation are different claims. None substitutes for another. Historical secondary claims of a $1 validation fee are not treated as a current quote.

freeShellProviders.name: envs.net
freeShellProviders.freeClaim: Homepage says non-commercial shared Linux system, always free to use
freeShellProviders.signup: Published request form: username, existing email/confirmation, interest statement, OpenSSH PUBLIC key and agreement; minimum 16 years
freeShellProviders.restrictions: Community rules and manual response; signup form availability does not guarantee acceptance or turnaround
freeShellProviders.ssh: Documentation lists envs.net ports 22 and 2222 and published SHA256 fingerprints; no live key comparison or login performed
freeShellProviders.androidPortCompatibility: Current APK has no private-key import; public-key-oriented providers may require a maintained full SSH client instead
freeShellProviders.recommendation: Practical Linux/community candidate subject to rules and approval; no signup performed

freeShellProviders.name: tilde.club
freeShellProviders.freeClaim: Community-supported shared Unix service; sampled signup/FAQ has no mandatory payment step (no guaranteed future fee schedule inferred)
freeShellProviders.signup: Published request form with username, email, interest statement and SSH PUBLIC key; minimum 13 years; reply with account information
freeShellProviders.restrictions: Code of conduct and manual approval; FAQ describes 1 GB soft / 3 GB hard quota and one-week grace
freeShellProviders.androidPortCompatibility: Public-key-oriented signup; private-key import is not implemented in this first APK
freeShellProviders.recommendation: Community/web learning candidate, not an instantly provisioned free VPS

freeShellProviders.name: freeshell.de
freeShellProviders.freeClaim: Homepage calls itself a non-profit free-shell provider; Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, web/email/database/container offerings advertised
freeShellProviders.signup: Request login/email, receive activation token by email, physically mail a postcard containing it, await activation
freeShellProviders.restrictions: Postal cost/time is not zero or instant; real resource quotas/approval not measured; no postcard requested or sent
freeShellProviders.recommendation: Consider if physical-postcard validation is acceptable; unrelated to the freewheel.org typo

freeShellProviders.name: tilde.institute
freeShellProviders.freeClaim: Public-access OpenBSD community; sampled joining page lists no payment step, not a commercial free-VPS guarantee
freeShellProviders.signup: Current joining page says join institute.tilde.chat:6697 with TLS, hang out and request an account there; not an automatic web signup
freeShellProviders.restrictions: No third-party malicious scanning/abuse or mining; user services subject to resource limits; no firewall-port exceptions promised
freeShellProviders.recommendation: OpenBSD/community-interest candidate subject to human approval

freeShellProviders.name: Blinkenshell
freeShellProviders.freeClaim: Basic free account plus separate paid supporter tier
freeShellProviders.signup: Published five-step process: email, rules/shell quiz, NickServ verification, two registered-user vouches (at least one-hour wait), SMS verification or contact admin if unavailable
freeShellProviders.restrictions: Basic accounts restrict bots/bouncers/servers and resource use; no account sharing, third-party host scanning or for-profit use; IRC participation expected
freeShellProviders.paidEnhancements: Supporter page quotes 3 EUR/month or 400 SEK/year via legacy PayPal route; signup page separately advertises optional 50 SEK instant activation. These are not unavoidable prices for the documented free route and no payment was made.
freeShellProviders.androidPortCompatibility: Menu-driven signup may require a full VT-capable terminal; this line-oriented APK is not that
freeShellProviders.recommendation: Suitable only if community vouch/SMS requirements and policy limits fit

freeShellProviders.name: tilde.team
freeShellProviders.freeClaim: Homepage says always free; signup form remains published
freeShellProviders.currentAvailabilityCaution: Homepage August 2026 outage notice reports a root compromise and explicitly says SSH access is currently disabled pending service migration, with a later update promised

freeShellProviders.recommendation: Hold: confirm an official restoration notice before considering; no operational probing performed
